name: Firepower Blockade
descriptionTemplate: When your attack causes the morale of the enemy to be low or diminished, there is X% probability to attack again. When your attack causes the morale of the enemy to go into chaos, there is 100% probability to attack again (inactive for enemies already in chaos)

progression.renderedDesc: When your attack causes the morale of the enemy to be low or diminished, there is 16% probability to attack again. When your attack causes the morale of the enemy to go into chaos, there is 100% probability to attack again (inactive for enemies already in chaos)
progression.renderedDescFr: Lorsque votre attaque rend le moral ennemi bas ou affaibli, 16% de chances d'attaquer à nouveau. Lorsque votre attaque met l'ennemi en déroute, 100% de chances d'attaquer à nouveau (sans effet sur les ennemis déjà en déroute)
progression.renderedDescDe: Senkt Ihr Angriff die Moral des Feindes auf niedrig oder geschwächt, besteht eine 16% Chance auf einen erneuten Angriff. Versetzt Ihr Angriff den Feind ins Chaos, beträgt die Chance 100% (wirkungslos gegen bereits chaotische Feinde)

longDesc: Compétence spécifique à un général. « Firepower Blockade » monte jusqu'au niveau 5. Au niveau maximum (5), elle applique l'effet suivant : « When your attaque causes the moral of the ennemi to be low or diminished, there is 80% probability to attaque again. When your attaque causes the moral of the ennemi to go into chaos, there is 100% probability to attaque again (inactive for ennemis already in chaos) ». Signature de carte — impossible à remplacer, définit souvent l'identité tactique du général.
longDescEn: A general-specific skill. "Firepower Blockade" scales up to level 5. At max level (5), the skill applies the following effect: "When your attack causes the morale of the enemy to be low or diminished, there is 80% probability to attack again. When your attack causes the morale of the enemy to go into chaos, there is 100% probability to attack again (inactive for enemies already in chaos)". A card signature — cannot be swapped; it often defines the general's tactical identity.
longDescDe: Eine generalspezifische Fähigkeit. „Firepower Blockade“ skaliert bis Stufe 5. Auf Maximalstufe (5) wirkt folgender Effekt: „When your attack causes the morale of the enemy to be low or diminished, there is 80% probability to attack again. When your attack causes the morale of the enemy to go into chaos, there is 100% probability to attack again (inactive for enemies already in chaos)“. Eine Karten-Signatur — nicht austauschbar, prägt oft die taktische Identität des Generals.
